subtitle: Sent, delivered, read, clicks and cost per template (from Meta).
enableFailed: Meta refused to enable template analytics.
enabled: Template analytics enabled. Click "Sync now" in a few minutes.
notConnected: No official WhatsApp account is connected yet. Connect one from WhatsApp → Connect account to see statistics.

error.title: Couldn't update statistics
error.body: We couldn't fetch the latest statistics from WhatsApp. This is usually temporary — try refreshing in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact support.
error.disabled: Template analytics are turned off for this WhatsApp Business Account, so Meta returns no template statistics. Enable them, then sync again in a few minutes.

activity.title: Account activity
activity.subtitle: Totals for the whole WhatsApp number, per day. Inbound service chat is excluded. Not broken down by template — WhatsApp does not report that at this level.
activity.empty: No account activity for this period. Click "Sync now" to fetch it from Meta.

kpi.uniqueUnavailable: Meta does not report unique clicks

buttons.title: Button clicks
buttons.empty: No button clicks (only Marketing/Utility templates report clicks).

cost.title: Cost
cost.currencyNote: In the WhatsApp Business Account's billing currency, as Meta reports it.

comparison.title: Per-template comparison
comparison.empty: No templates with statistics in this period.

guide.intro: Our REST API lets another system (your website, CRM or ERP) send WhatsApp messages through the shop's official WhatsApp number and receive its events. Create a key from WhatsApp → API Keys and an events URL from WhatsApp → API Webhooks.
guide.format: Requests and responses are JSON (Content-Type: application/json). Every response carries "success": true or false.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.body: Every request carries an API key. Keys start with m1wa_ and are shown only once, when created — store it on your server and never in a browser or mobile app.
auth.point1: Send the key in one of these headers:
auth.point2: A key can be pinned to one WhatsApp number; it then sends only from that number. An unpinned key sends from the default number unless you pass whatsapp_account_id.
auth.point3: A disabled or deleted key answers 401 immediately.

accounts.title: Discover accounts
accounts.body: Lists the WhatsApp numbers this key can send from. Use "id" (the phone number id) as whatsapp_account_id in other calls.

templates.title: List templates
templates.body: Returns the templates saved in the system (approved only by default; status=all returns every status). Each template lists its body variables and which buttons take a variable (buttons_variables), so you know exactly what to send.

sendTemplate.title: Send a template
sendTemplate.body: Templates are the only way to start a conversation or write to a customer more than 24 hours after their last message. The template must be approved by Meta.
sendTemplate.fieldTo: Recipient phone number in international format, digits only (e.g. 201000000000). A leading + is accepted.
sendTemplate.fieldTemplate: The template's name (template_name or template), or its id (template_id: our id or Meta's).
sendTemplate.fieldLanguage: Language code (e.g. ar, en). Optional when the template exists in one language only.
sendTemplate.fieldVariables: Body variable values: a list in order ({{1}}, {{2}}…) or an object ("1", "2"… or named keys).
sendTemplate.fieldButtons: Values for buttons that take a variable, keyed by the button's position (0-based): the dynamic part of a URL button, or a copy-code value.
sendTemplate.fieldHeader: Header value: { type: image|video|document, url, filename } for a media header, or { text } for a text header with a variable.
sendTemplate.fieldAccount: Optional: which number sends (phone number id from /accounts).
sendTemplate.variablesBody: A list is sent in order. An object with numeric keys is sorted by key; any other key is sent as a named parameter (for templates written with named placeholders).
sendTemplate.languageBody: When the template exists in more than one language and you don't pass language, the request is refused with WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_AMBIGUOUS and the available languages. A template name we don't have saved is still sent to Meta (language "ar" when not given).
sendTemplate.mediaTitle: Media header and dynamic URL buttons
sendTemplate.mediaBody: A media header needs a public https link to the file for every send. For a URL button like https://example.com/track/{{1}} send only the variable part in buttons_variables.
sendTemplate.responseBody: On success you get 201 with the WhatsApp message id (wamid). "accepted" means Meta took the message; delivery and read arrive later (poll the status or use webhooks).

session.title: Send a session message
session.body: Free-form text, or a file by public URL: type text (default), image, video, audio or document, with an optional caption (not for audio) and filename (documents).
session.window: Session messages only reach the customer within 24 hours of their last message. Outside that window Meta refuses with error 131047 — either straight away (the request fails as below) or later, as a message.status "failed" event with that code. Send a template instead.

status.title: Poll message status
status.body: Returns the latest status of a message: accepted → sent → delivered → read, or failed with failure_reason. Messages sent through this API are tracked from the moment they are sent; messages the inbox knows about (including inbound ones, status "received") are found too.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: Add an events URL from WhatsApp → API Webhooks and pick its events. The signing secret (whsec_…) is shown once, when the webhook is created. Each event is a POST with this body: event, created_at and data.
webhooks.eventReceived: A customer sent a message to the number.
webhooks.eventStatus: A sent message became sent, delivered, read or failed.
webhooks.eventSent: A message was sent through this API.
webhooks.eventTemplate: A template's review status changed on Meta (approved, rejected, paused, disabled…).
webhooks.verifyBody: X-M1-Signature is sha256= followed by the hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body with your secret. Compute it over the exact bytes received (before parsing JSON) and compare in constant time.
webhooks.delivery1: Answer with any 2xx status within 5 seconds; do the heavy work afterwards.
webhooks.delivery2: Each event is delivered once — there are no automatic retries. Use GET /messages/{wamid} to fill any gap.
webhooks.delivery3: After 20 failed deliveries in a row the webhook is disabled automatically; enabling it again from the inbox resets the counter.
webhooks.delivery4: The URL must be public (no localhost or private addresses) and redirects are not followed.
webhooks.rotateBody: Issues a new signing secret and returns it once; the old one stops working immediately. A key pinned to a number can only rotate webhooks of that number.

errors.title: Errors
errors.body: Every error returns success: false with a message, a stable code and, for WhatsApp errors, a short meaning.
errors.keyMissing: No API key in the request.
errors.keyInvalid: The key is wrong, disabled or deleted.
errors.accountNotAllowed: The key is pinned to another WhatsApp number.
errors.phone: "to" is missing or not a phone number.
errors.text: "text" is empty, or longer than 4096 characters.
errors.type: "type" is not text, image, video, audio or document.
errors.media: The file link is not a public http(s) URL, or the caption is longer than 1024 characters.
errors.templateName: The template name may only contain lowercase letters, digits and _.
errors.ambiguous: The template exists in several languages — pass language.
errors.messageNotFound: No message with that wamid for this account.
errors.webhookNotFound: No webhook with that id (or not on this key's number).
errors.notConnected: No official WhatsApp number is connected (or the key's number was disconnected).
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests — wait for Retry-After seconds.
errors.window: Outside the 24-hour service window — send a template.
errors.notApproved: The template does not exist on Meta in that language, or is not approved.
errors.paramCount: The number of variables does not match the template.
errors.recipient: This number cannot receive WhatsApp messages.
errors.token: The WhatsApp connection's token expired — reconnect the number.
errors.metaLimit: Meta's own sending limits were reached — slow down and retry later.
errors.metaOther: Any other error from WhatsApp, passed through with its message.
errors.timeout: WhatsApp did not answer in time — retry.

limits.title: Rate limits
limits.point1: 60 requests per minute per API key, across all endpoints (a fixed one-minute window).
limits.point2: Every response reports the limit and what is left:
limits.point3: Over the limit you get 429 WHATSAPP_API_RATE_LIMITED with
limits.point4: Meta also limits sending per number and per recipient; those errors are passed through unchanged.
